text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan was the one who triumphed in 
the heated Tenno Sho (Spring). Ines Fujin 
let her frustration explode.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without letting it get to her head, Mejiro 
Ryan expresses her gratitude to the fans. 
It is the majestic demeanor of one who 
carries great expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin watched that scene. Feeling the 
gap between herself and Mejiro Ryan, she 
began to reflect on how to face the cheers 
of support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Can she become like Mejiro Ryan? To help 
her find that answer, let's build up her 
training for the Takarazuka Kinen!
